talking_points: Anthropic and OpenAI have both slashed prices on their newest models, signalling that the AI price war is now about efficiency, not just raw power.
Big Tech's AI-fuelled borrowing spree is meeting resistance as bond investors demand higher yields from the likes of Alphabet, Meta and Nvidia.
A wave of eye-watering valuations continues in AI startups, from Legora's $8.5bn ask to a data-centre IPO seeking a $5.4bn price tag.
